pages.title: Take a Deep Breath
pages.text: Prepare for the abyss before entering it.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the Deep Sea Diving Helmet from its recipe and read how its air system works. Wearing it is the objective; the journal does not measure your dive.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Obtain diving pieces from local Drowned or Abyssal Ruins. Helmet air replenishes out of water; chestplate improves protection, leggings swimming and boots muck travel.
